title: Station drag and mid-line turns (stage g)
text: T-4037, track stage g: (1) dragging a station or platform end slides it along its track, with bending done by dragging the track's own points? I'd say yes. (2) Once g lands every new station sits inside a piece, and a train can't turn back at such a stop between a line's ends today; give that turn a form in the path in stage g so lines that reverse at a middle stop keep working? I'd say yes.
